note: Shadow variant of cfb_shop v2, paper-tracked alongside it (v2 keeps running unchanged). Changes come from the 2021-25 segment study (output/research/round3/cfb_shop_segments.md), which sliced the same data that validated v2, so v3 must prove itself on 2026+ bets before it replaces anything: (1) OVERS need EV >= 4% (overs kept only 26% of their EV at the close vs 83% for unders; overs at EV 2-3% were worth ~+0.7% CLV); unders, spreads and moneylines keep their v2 bars. (2) Stake = quarter Kelly on the EV after the market's average EV-to-CLV gap (totals 1.9%, spreads 1.3%, moneylines 0). Everything else (books, price range, 60 min..7 days, one bet per game per market, Shin devig) as v2. Pass: >= 150 bets, CLV > 0 at p < 0.01, ROI > 0, and CLV per bet above v2's on the same games. Do not edit to fit results; bump the version.

qualify.one_bet_per_game_per_market: first qualifying snapshot, best EV across books and sides at that snapshot

sizing.method: quarter Kelly vs the Pinnacle fair price, capped

grading.clv: EV of our bet (same number and price) under Pinnacle's last pre-kickoff quote of that market, key-number pricing
grading.result: CFBD final score; pushes return the stake

version_4_note: Only change: your books only (my_books.json), same as the main shop track v3. Stricter overs (EV>=4%) and haircut sizing unchanged.
